title: Appointment Series Late-Arrival Fee — Amount
content:
Rate card note: the amount of a late-arrival fee on an Appointment Series.

**Amount.** The late-arrival fee is the late-arrival basis, and the late-arrival basis is the late-cancellation fee of the series' visit format. Rounding to the nearest cent happens only once, on the final amount.

**Read from.** The visit format on the series record and that format's late-cancellation fee.

**Example (hypothetical figure).** A format whose late-cancellation fee is USD 40.00 gives a late-arrival basis of USD 40.00 and a late-arrival fee of USD 40.00.
